relationships.subject: ANG-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Ang-1, acting through the Tie-2 receptor, remodels vessels and stabilizes mature vessels through interactions between endothelial cells and the surrounding support cells [33].

relationships.subject: VEGF/HGF/ANG-1 plasmid gene therapy
relationships.evidence_quote: The scores of patients in Group 1 decreased from 6.80 ± 1.48 to 2.10 ± 1.10, and those of patients in Group 2 decreased from 7.44 ± 1.42 to 3.78 ± 1.64 (Table 1).

key_findings: Sequential VEGF165/HGF then ANG-1 plasmid gene therapy improved wound healing, ABI and PtcO2 in diabetic foot critical limb ischemia.
Resting pain decreased in both gene therapy and control groups.
